snapshot.baseline: Proposed v2 environment isolation and promotion policy

records.name: Local and CI
records.isolation: Dedicated PostgreSQL 17/Redis containers or ephemeral services; emulator/test Firebase; fake provider adapters by default
records.deployable: Same application image build inputs; no production credentials
records.gate: Blank bootstrap, upgrade/rollback, contract, authorization, worker restart and drift tests

records.name: Staging
records.data_class: Synthetic and explicitly sanitized migration fixtures only
records.isolation: Separate Supabase, Firebase, Redis, storage, providers and credentials
records.deployable: Exact immutable image later promoted to production
records.gate: Full mobile/API/security/privacy/provider failure/backup-restore exercise; zero open Critical/High and P0/P1

records.name: Production
records.data_class: User account and health-related application data
records.isolation: Dedicated company-owned accounts, credentials and stable company API hostname
records.deployable: Immutable staging-proven image; migrations run once before service start
records.gate: Typed fail-closed config, owner/legal/clinical decisions, release thresholds, tested rollback/restore and two administrators

records.name: Legacy evidence archive
records.purpose: Encrypted restricted migration and behavior evidence only
records.data_class: Legacy application rows, objects and sanitized fixtures under approved retention
records.isolation: No serving application access; no public ingress; access logged
records.deployable: Not a rollback target and never receives v2 writes
records.gate: Checksum, access list, retention/erasure decision and owner sign-off
